settings.hero_desc: A clean white massing model of a mixed-use development - towers, podiums and landscaped spaces laid out to scale on a presentation base. The ideal tool for pitching a development to investors and buyers. Price given is for each building.
settings.perso_placeholder: Your development, massing, landscaping and base
settings.s1_body: Before a development is built, a massing model lets people see it. We translate your masterplan into a crisp white model - towers, podium buildings, roads and landscaped areas all to scale - so investors, partners and buyers grasp the scheme instantly. A clean, professional centrepiece for sales suites, investor pitches and planning presentations.
settings.case_body: Built to present a mixed-use scheme in Exhibition, this massing model gave the sales team a tangible centrepiece - investors and buyers could see the whole development laid out, understanding the vision far faster than from drawings.
settings.case_quote: It was the centrepiece of the event. We attached RFID under the model to make it more interactive.
settings.prov_p: Renders and drawings ask people to imagine; a physical model lets them see. A clean massing model turns a masterplan into something investors and buyers can walk around and believe in.
